<!-- pr-reviewer: 2bda761cd9aa969b3cf1e8d48e8afedba117d286 -->
Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4129, claude-fable-5-2, mkinney/claude-team2; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: ready for a collaborator to merge.** No blocking finding.

This is the first review of this PR. I read the full diff (2 files, +18 -2).

Tier: not a safety-tier review. The diff changes one test file and one decision file. It does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, the stock simulation or geometry. It does not change `crates/ui`, so screenshots are not necessary.

## What is good

- The fix is the one that issue #4120 specifies. The parent test and `check_disk_recovery` build the folder with `.join("assets").join("machines")`.
- The reader builds its folder the same way: `crates/post/src/data_dir.rs:80` uses `dir.join("assets").join(kind)`. Thus the two paths have the same separators on each OS.
- The reader does not change. No production code changes.
- The `contains` check on the folder path stays. The test still refuses a reader that uses a different folder (see "Mutation").
- `docs/decisions/4120-windows-path-sep.md` records what was chosen and what was dropped. The remaining `../../assets/machines/3axis-vmc.mch` at `disk_recovery.rs:75` is only opened, not compared as text. I agree that it can stay.
- The body is honest about what was not run (Windows) and why a red-before-fix reading is not possible on macOS.

## Results, merged with main

Built locally on host `m3` (macOS, arm64). No GitHub runner was used. The trial merge of head `2bda761cd` with upstream main `021bba4d9` is clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (1 step: `app default_machine_missing (disk_recovery::)`) | ok, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test default_machine_missing` | 10 passed, 0 failed |
| Pin: `disk_recovery::a_repaired_default_machine_file_is_read_again_through_the_disk_reader` | passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no fixture, no golden and no importer code.

Example catalog, light lane and heavy lanes: not reached. The diff changes no post, operation, motion or catalog file. No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`) changes, and "Goldens moved: None" in the body is correct.

## Mutation

I ran one mutation locally and then removed it.

- Mutation: in `check_disk_recovery`, the compared folder became `.join("assets").join("machinez")`.
- Result: red. The child fails at `disk_recovery.rs:63` with `the reader must use the isolated folder: ... in /var/folders/.../.tmpvhsPkU/assets/machines: No such file or directory`. The parent then fails at `disk_recovery.rs:38`.
- Without the mutation: green again.

This shows that the path check is live and that the reader reads the isolated folder.

## Law check

- Conventional subject, commit body ends with `Fixes #4120`, PR body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #4120`: ok.
- Test placement: the file stays in the existing `default_machine_missing` directory suite. Its Gate map does not change: ok.
- No process file, no dependency, no `build.rs`, no `.github/`, no snapshot PNG, no `CHANGELOG.md` change: ok.
- `expect()` occurs only in test code: ok.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes, not blocking

1. Windows is not exercised. I cannot run Windows on this host. Issue #4120 says "Done means: the test passes on Windows (`bacon`, `lenny` or `winnie`)". The body says that the M5 session runs this check. Post the Windows result as a comment on this PR or on #4120. The test is already red on Windows on main, so a merge cannot make Windows worse.
2. `docs/decisions/4120-windows-path-sep.md:1` starts with `# 4120 - ...`. `docs/decisions/README.md` gives the heading format `## #N - <title>`, and each other file in the folder uses it. `cargo xtask decisions` appends the file as it is, so this heading becomes a level-1 heading in `RECOMMENDED.md`. Change the line to `## #4120 - ...` if a later push occurs, or at the cut. Do not push only for this.

A collaborator's session merges this PR through `/merge-ready`.

Windows check on head `2bda761cd9aa969b3cf1e8d48e8afedba117d286`.

Host `winnie` (Windows 11): `cargo test -q -p camcraft-app --test default_machine_missing`.
Result: 10 passed, 0 failed. This includes `disk_recovery::a_repaired_default_machine_file_is_read_again_through_the_disk_reader`, which failed on `main` on this host and on `bacon` (#4120).
